pages.text: “Warmly nourishes the body, replenishes vital energy, and restores stamina.”$(br2)Astragalus Soup is a restorative medicinal broth made from dried astragalus and sugar. The golden-yellow tea is transparent and exudes a rich herbal aroma. Consuming it provides health regeneration and alleviates hunger.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Astragalus Soup, $(br)boil two portions of dried astragalus with sugar. $(br)It is best consumed when hungry or fatigued, helping travelers regain their strength and continue their journey.

Upon drinking Astragalus Soup, travelers will receive a health regeneration effect and have their hunger alleviated, restoring vitality. $(br)This nourishing medicinal broth is ideal for long journeys. $(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
